shelters.name: Animal Humane Society
shelters.description: Open admission guarantees safe refuge to every animal. In 2024, Humane Investigations impacted 8,823 animals across 80 of 87 counties. Pet food pantry distributed 30+ tons of food.

shelters.name: Saint Paul Animal Control
shelters.description: Releases most animals to approved rescue partners. Overall live release rate of 90% or higher since 2016.

shelters.name: Minnesota Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving the Twin Cities and greater Minnesota area.

shelters.name: Tri-County Humane Society
shelters.description: Independent nonprofit where 100% of charitable gifts directly benefit animals. No government funding. Nearly 1,000 animals need foster care each year.

shelters.name: Animal Allies Humane Society
shelters.description: Dedicated to a compassionate journey for pets and people in the Duluth community.

shelters.name: Pet Haven
shelters.description: Minnesota's oldest foster-based rescue. Every animal lives with a loving foster family until it finds its own family.

shelters.name: Animal Ark
shelters.description: No-kill since 1977. Embraces no-kill philosophy to rescue, rehabilitate, and rehome Minnesota's lost and homeless companion animals.

shelters.name: Ruff Start Rescue
shelters.description: Dedicated to saving lives of animals in need. Improves animal welfare through adoption, education, and providing resources.

shelters.name: Second Chance Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Incorporated 1994, 501(c)(3) all-volunteer organization rescuing, caring for, and adopting out homeless dogs and cats.

shelters.name: Carver Scott Humane Society
shelters.description: Foster-based rescue. Can only save as many animals as they have foster homes available.

shelters.name: The Bond Between
shelters.description: Offers Respite Foster Care for pet owners experiencing domestic violence. Provides adoption, rescue, and fostering services.

shelters.name: Waseca County Animal Humane Society
shelters.description: No-kill 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. Dogs and cats for adoption in Minnesota.

shelters.name: Angel of Hope Animal Rescue
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to rescuing and providing loving care and vet care to animals in need.

shelters.name: Heart of Minnesota Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Animal shelter serving central Minnesota communities.

shelters.name: Mesabi Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving the Iron Range region of northern Minnesota.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Minnesota animal shelters, humane societies, and rescue organizations. Animal Humane Society is the state's largest with open admission. Pet Haven is Minnesota's oldest foster-based rescue. Animal Ark has been no-kill since 1977. Coverage spans Minneapolis/St. Paul metro, Duluth, St. Cloud, Waseca, and central Minnesota.
